c.description:
2 Bedroom Apartment for Rent in Kitsilano, Vancouver
Kits Court Apartments at 2425 and 2475 West 4th Avenue is a professionally managed rental property located in Vancouver’s vibrant Kitsilano neighbourhood, steps from the shops, cafés and restaurants of West 4th Avenue. This desirable Westside location offers convenient access to Kitsilano Beach, Kitsilano Pool, the Arbutus Greenway, Granville Island and Downtown Vancouver, with shopping, dining, recreation and transit nearby.

West 4th Avenue is just steps from the property, offering a wide selection of local shops, restaurants, cafés and everyday conveniences. Nearby beaches, parks and tree-lined residential streets provide easy access to outdoor recreation, while convenient transit connections make it easy to travel throughout Vancouver.

SUITE & BUILDING FEATURES
Suites feature spacious floorplans, dishwashers, in-suite laundry and private decks. Secured underground parking and storage are available for an additional fee, subject to availability.

Copy and paste for a Virtual Tour:
https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=od8UYnDGfaA

WALKABLE & CONNECTED LOCATION
Kits Court Apartments offers an exceptionally walkable and bike-friendly Kitsilano location, with a Walk Score of 94 (Walker’s Paradise) and Bike Score of 91 (Biker’s Paradise). Shopping, dining, recreation, transit and some of Vancouver’s most popular destinations are all nearby.

Walk Score 94 — Walker’s Paradise
http://www.walkscore.com/score/2475-West-4th-Avenue-Vancouver

Nearby amenities and destinations include:
• West 4th Avenue Shopping District (steps away)
• Kitsilano Public Library (10 min walk)
• Kitsilano Community Centre (10 min walk)
• Arbutus Greenway (10 min walk)
• Kitsilano Beach (15 min walk)
• Kitsilano Pool (15 min walk)
• Vanier Park (25 min walk)
• Granville Island (30 min walk)

Images and virtual tours may depict a similar floor plan and may be virtually staged. Actual suite finishes, features and layouts may vary.
